name: linkedin
label: LinkedIn
description: Post to LinkedIn profiles and Company Pages

oauth2.scope: w_member_social w_organization_social rw_organization_admin openid email profile

get_current_member_profile.label: Get Current Member Profile
get_current_member_profile.description: Get the profile of the LinkedIn member who owns the connection

list_managed_organizations.label: List Managed Organizations
list_managed_organizations.description: List the LinkedIn organization pages the connected member administers

update_post_commentary.label: Update Post Commentary
update_post_commentary.description: Edit the commentary, call-to-action label or landing page of an existing LinkedIn post

post_urn.label: Post URN
post_urn.description: URN of the post to edit, for example urn:li:share:7212345678901234567.

commentary.label: Commentary
commentary.description: New body text. Leave empty to keep the current text.

content_call_to_action_label.label: Call To Action Label
content_call_to_action_label.description: New call-to-action button label. Leave empty to keep the current one.

content_landing_page.label: Landing Page URL
content_landing_page.description: New destination for the call-to-action button. Leave empty to keep the current one.

create_image_upload_url.label: Create Image Upload URL
create_image_upload_url.description: Reserve a LinkedIn image URN and a URL to upload the bytes to

owner_urn.label: Owner URN
owner_urn.description: Who will own the image, such as the member URN that Get Current Member Profile gives.

create_image_upload_url.beforeRequest:
if (!inputs.owner_urn) throw new Error('Owner URN is needed: use the member URN that Get Current Member Profile gives.');
return request;
